connection.notInstalledBody: PartBuddy shows and changes designs through SolidCraft, a free CAD program. Install SolidCraft, then look again.
connection.notRunningBody: Start SolidCraft here, or open it yourself; PartBuddy finds it on its own.
connection.startingBody: The SolidCraft window opens. Its control channel takes up to half a minute.
connection.lostTitle: The connection to SolidCraft was lost
connection.lostBody: PartBuddy keeps the last model and connects again as soon as SolidCraft answers.
connection.emptyBody: Create a body in SolidCraft or let the assistant design one. It appears here after every step.
connection.mirrorFailedTitle: The model could not be mirrored
connection.mirrorFailedBody: PartBuddy shows the last good state. Details: {detail}

viewer.errorTitle: The model could not be read
viewer.errorBody: The mirrored file is damaged or has an unknown format ({message}).
viewer.hint: Click a face to select it. Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

status.mesh: {bodies, plural, one {# body} other {# bodies}} · {faces, plural, one {# face} other {# faces}} · {triangles} triangles

assistant.title: Assistant

claude-code.signedOut: Not signed in to Claude Code

assistant.notInstalledBody: PartBuddy uses your own Claude Code with your Claude subscription. Install Claude Code from Anthropic, then look again.
assistant.signedOutBody: Claude Code opens Anthropic’s sign-in page in your browser. PartBuddy never sees your account data.
assistant.unavailableTitle: Claude Code could not be started
assistant.empty: Describe what SolidCraft should build or change. Every step appears in the 3D view.
assistant.needsSolidCraft: Connect SolidCraft first; the assistant works on the open design.
assistant.placeholder: For example: a 40 × 20 × 5 mm plate with two 4 mm holes
assistant.stopped: Stopped before the answer was complete.

chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser
chatgpt.signedOutBody: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. Requests count towards your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan; PartBuddy keeps the sign-in only in the Windows credential store.
chatgpt.planDisabledTitle: ChatGPT plan usage is not allowed

live.thinking: The assistant is planning the next step
live.changed: {count, plural, one {# face changed} other {# faces changed}}
